entry.title: Updated: dsh-companion
entry.summary: Four-module session companion: smart conversation export (Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG long-image with privacy redaction and batch ZIP), context handoff summaries with template save/import, API cost optimization (live official pricing, peak/off-peak scheduling, daily/monthly budgets, model routing), and global conversation search with in-chat find (Ctrl+F, CSS Custom Highlight API). Exact install spec: github:beijingwahw/dsh-companion. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
